tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje srin po'i sgo nas rang gshed dbab pa bung ba khrag 'thung bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje srin po la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen bsgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /snying rje'i shugs drag po'i nyams cher khros pas phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharm+maḥ swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dregs pa can thams cad kyi nus pa bsdus/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje srin po sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing 'tsher ba/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rdo rje'i rdul phra mo dang sprul pa'i khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa 'phro ba/ khros pa'i spyan gsum me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba/ zhal gdangs shing ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭ phaṭ la sogs pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ mche ba zla ba tshes pa lta bur rnam par gtsigs pa/ ljags rab tu 'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thung la gel zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad dang phyag rgya drug klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i stang stabs kyis gnam lcags kyi thog ser 'bebs pa'i me dang dud sprin 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong g.yas su drag por 'khor ba'i shugs kyis pho brgyud kyi byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa brgyal zhing brgyal bar byed pa/ g.yon dang po zangs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong g.yon du 'khor bas mo brgyud kyi byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thor thor gtong ba/ g.yas 'og ma zla ba dang*/ g.yon 'og ma nyi ma/ de nyid kyi bar du byad mas btang ba'i lha srung de rnams bung ba nag po'i rnam par mang po byung ba de dag nyi zla'i bar du brdabs/

nyi ma'i mes bsreg rdul du song*/ zla ba las chu byung*/ des sbrus pas 'jim par song*/ slar shin tu 'jigs pa'i bung ba mang por gyur te lha srin gyi dmag mang po ra mdar sbran/ nged cag gdug pa 'di phas kyi byad byed mkhan khos lan pa yin bsam de dag kho la khros 'khrugs nas/ bu ga dgu dang ba spu'i khung thams cad nas zhugs te rtsa zos khrag brngubs/ sha rus 'bus gzhig pa ltar lhag med du btang bar bsam la/ aye tsa tsa oṃ ā hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ u u u/ e e e/ a a a/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra kā wu wa wa pa shā ya ma hā kā yā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ u ne u ne u ne/ u u u/ ka pa ye/ mu ka ye/ a pa ye/ hri da ye/ sing da ye/ byi ta ye/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na rakṣa/ ya ma he dun/ tsā munḍi shag e rag ga dhe bi sha mo ha ma ma i ri/ a a a/ u ne u ne u ne/ du ne du ne du ne/ li li li/ i i i/ rme phrag rbud/ snying khrag rbud/ snying la 'thibs/ shag ti khas/ rma ra ya phaṭ rbad/ byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa sarba mā ra ya myags thum ril rbad/ rakta 'thibs/ tsatti khas/ trig myags rbad sod/ u nan u nan/ staṃ bha ya/ ka pa ye/ badzra yakṣa rākṣa/ u u u/ dun dun dun/ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ siṃ sa ru mun/ sa ma ya thum ril/ a tro hri swi rakṣa sa ma ya/ tsaṇḍa ro ṣa ṇa/ byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa myags thum ril/ tril nan sbur ya nan/ e hur thum dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ rbad 'dre byad ma la breng shag bhyo zlog ces bzla'o// dmigs rten 'ben du bca' na/ bdug pa'i sa la 'brub khung nang du liṅga sngags kyi bskor ba/ ting nge 'dzin sngar bzhin la/ thun rdzas brdeg cing sngags bzla/ mthar gzhan du bshad pa'i brdab las kyi mthar ling ro gtor chen dang lhan du 'phang bar bya'o// yang na drag po'i shing gis bsreg go rdo rje srin po'i sgo nas byad ma rang gshed du dbab pa'i man ngag padma dkar pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /maṅga laṃ/// /
